maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring broadband, cable TV and phone subscriptions, plus Glo Fiber build-outs, not repair or replacement of owned items.

publicly_funded.reason: Households and businesses pay monthly subscriptions for internet, TV and phone; state broadband grants are only a small part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by building its own Glo Fiber network and selling subscriptions, not through regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Residential and business broadband is essential connectivity; switching means installation, downtime and new equipment, and few rural alternatives exist.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgement call; residential customers can switch to other providers where those exist.
